detail:
NEW keys not settled either way. Each stays here until its missing evidence is supplied.

R7|fnn-dev-evaluate|swallow:serious-condition:fault,indet (dev-repl.lisp:60): the handler consumes any condition from fnn-owner-serialized + eval into status ERROR and a printed message; the docstring claims 'Evaluation errors follow the owner's normal fault/fence boundary'. Missing: a read of fnn-section-run's fault path showing it fences (and resignals or marks *fnn-dev-admission-failed*) before the condition reaches this handler; if it does the key is a MODEL-GAP of the funcall-boundary kind, otherwise REAL.
R7|fnn-dev-repl-loop|swallow:serious-condition:fault (dev-repl.lisp:172): accept loop continues after any condition. lmg notes it as private by design (developer image only, io.lisp:6958-6977, owner-only socket) but that is a design exemption, not a checker model fact. Missing: Deputy C ruling whether developer-image loops are exempt from R7 (then a contract row), plus the same evaluate-path fact as above.
fix: Settle per key as written; then move to LOCK-CHECKER-MODEL-GAPS or file a LOCK-R7-* item.
notes: 2026-10-07 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R7|fnn-dev-repl-loop|swallow:serious-condition:fault REAL: the developer accept/read/send boundary catches a fnn-store-fault from connection framing outside fnn-owner-serialized; no owner fence has run and the loop logs then retries. Planned change: explicit fault/indeterminate clauses invoke fnn-owner-thread-escape before the connection-local diagnostic handler; ordinary socket errors retain their scope.

2026-10-08 lock-r1-class STATEMENT R7|fnn-dev-evaluate|swallow:serious-condition:fault,indet GAP: fnn-owner-serialized calls fnn-section-run; its fnn-section-envelope gates admission and uses fnn-owner-shared-action-locked, which classifies/fences before re-signalling, with a fault fence on unclassified unwind and gate-leave failure. The diagnostic handler receives an already fenced evaluation condition. The missing checker rule must propagate fenced-condition provenance through that boundary while retaining red for a fault raised before it or a removed fence. No developer-image exemption. Still open; no code change for this key.
title: Lock checker NEW keys left UNSURE (dev REPL R7 pair): evidence still missing
